# Halcyon Threshold — working plan (Nov 2026)

Mission: contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

## Where we are
- Solo founder (Morgan), evenings and weekends, up to $2,000 of savings this year.
- Public-facing name is on hold until Morgan has talked to HR about the Dorrance
  outside-activities clause (disclosure due 30 Nov). Nothing goes out under Morgan's
  name in public until then.
- Domain halcyonthreshold.org expires 19 Nov (renewal needs Morgan's OK).
- Inbound interest: a rapid grant round (Emberfall, closes 30 Nov), a reading-group
  idea, an offer of volunteer help (Priya Raman), press and open-letter requests.

## Working hypothesis
A small team with little money does best by finding neglected, checkable questions
rather than competing with large labs on scale. Candidate first projects:
1. A reading group on alignment and governance, with notes published openly.
2. A small evaluation pilot on a question nobody is measuring well (to be chosen with input).
3. A small-grants round for independent researchers, once there is money to give.

## Open questions
- Research, writing, or funding other people? (Morgan's notes.)
- What Morgan is able to put their name to, given the employment agreement.

## Next steps (no spend, no sending without Morgan)
- Draft grant proposal for Emberfall (docs/grants/emberfall-rapid-draft.md), for review.
- Draft a reply to Priya asking what would be most useful, for review.
- Wait for Morgan on: domain renewal, grant submission, press and open-letter requests.

# DRAFT — Emberfall Fund rapid grants (closes 30 Nov 2026)

STATUS: draft for Morgan's review. NOT SUBMITTED.
Before submitting: Morgan to confirm (a) the Dorrance outside-activities disclosure
(section 7) is handled, since this would be a named outside role; (b) the budget
figures; (c) willingness to be the accountable applicant.

## 1. What I will do (6 months)
Run a small, open programme on alignment and governance questions that are under-examined:
- A monthly reading group, with written summaries published openly on halcyonthreshold.org.
- One small, checkable evaluation pilot on a question chosen with input from the group.
- A short public write-up of what was learned, including what did not work.

## 2. Why me
- I have been working on AI safety questions for [N] years [Morgan to fill in].
- I have a day job, so I can commit evenings and weekends: about [X] hours/week.
- I already have contacts in the field from meetups [Morgan to fill in].
- The project is deliberately small so that it can be run and reviewed honestly.

## 3. What it costs
| Item | Amount (USD) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Domain and hosting | 15 + 240 | Renewal + hosting plan (Pro is $20/mo; free tier may suffice) |
| Compute for eval pilot | 600 | Cloud credits, capped |
| Reading materials and tools | 150 | |
| Writing and admin contingency | 0 | Morgan's time, unpaid |
| **Total requested** | **[e.g. 10,000]** | Round range is $5k–$25k |

Morgan's own contribution: up to $2,000 of savings (already planned).

## 4. Accountability
Morgan Hale is the named applicant and is accountable for the work, its spending, and
public outputs. Records (receipts, a spending log) will be kept in the repository.

## 5. Risks
- Limited time (volunteer, part-time). Mitigation: small scope, honest milestones.
- Overlap with other groups. Mitigation: check and publish the list of similar work.
